name: io.github.tonyyang0504/bybit-mcp
description: Bybit (Unified) (trading): me, list_markets, get_ticker, get_candles, get_balances, list_orders, pla

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_BYBIT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Bybit API key (system-generated HMAC key) with Read + Trade (Spot/Contract) and NO Wallet/Transfer/Withdraw permission. Testnet keys come from https://testnet.bybit.com and work only against https://api-testnet.bybit.com (set adapter.base_url to it).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_BYBIT_API_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: The key's secret: HMAC-SHA256 over timestamp + api_key + recv_window (5000) + query string (GET) or JSON body (POST), sent as X-BAPI-SIGN. Never sent on the wire.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_BYBIT_CATEGORY
environmentVariables.description: Bybit product category every tool works on: `spot` or `linear` (USDT/USDC perpetuals and futures).
